# Vibrok

> Italian manufacturer of premium heating stoves, fireplaces, pellet stoves, wood-fired ovens, and barbecues made in Paliano since 1975.

Vibrok is a specialized producer of heating and cooking appliances with a focus on traditional Italian craftsmanship and energy efficiency. The company manufactures a comprehensive range of products including wood-burning and pellet heating systems, fireplace inserts, traditional fireplaces, outdoor ovens, and biomass boilers.

## Key Topics

- Pellet stoves
- Wood-burning stoves
- Termocamini (heating fireplaces)
- Fireplace inserts
- Wood-fired ovens
- Biomass boilers
- Made in Italy
- Energy efficiency
- Hydronic heating
- Home heating systems
- Paliano, Italy
- Traditional fireplaces
- Garden barbecues
- Double combustion system
- ISO 9001 certified

## Heating Stoves & Termocamini

- [Termocamini Aria | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/termocamini-aria): Product catalog for Termocamini Aria wood-burning heating stoves with energy efficiency.
- [Termocamini Idro | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/termocamini-idro): Hydronic wood-burning termocamini for heating and hot water production.
- [Stufe a Pellet - Tradizionali e Canalizzate | Vibrok Fabbrica Stufe a Pellet](https://www.vibrok.it/stufe-tradizionali): Traditional and channelizable pellet stoves manufactured in Paliano, Italy.
- [Termostufe a Pellet | Riscaldamento e Acqua Calda | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/termostufe): Pellet-burning heating stoves for home heating and hot water production.
- [Stufe a Legna | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/stufe-a-legna): Wood-burning stoves with Italian design and energy efficiency.

## Fireplace Inserts & Traditional Fireplaces

- [Inserti Aria a Legna (Termocamini da incasso) | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/termocamini-da-incasso-inserti-aria-a-legna): Built-in air-heating wood-burning fireplace inserts with glass doors.
- [Inserti Idro a Legna (Termocamini da Incasso) | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/inserti-camini): Recessed hydronic wood-burning fireplace inserts for traditional fireplaces.
- [Caminetti tradizionali aperti | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/caminetti-tradizionali-aperti): Traditional open wood-burning fireplaces with classic Italian design.
- [Caminetti tradizionali con anta a vetro | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/caminetti-tradizionali-con-antina): Traditional wood-burning fireplaces with ceramic glass doors.

## Ovens & Outdoor Cooking

- [Forni tradizionali | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/forni-tradizionali): Traditional wood-fired ovens for domestic and professional use.
- [Forni a Legna da Giardino - Forni Pizza da Esterno | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/forni-a-legna-da-giardino): Outdoor garden wood-fired pizza ovens in stainless steel.
- [Forni a Legna da Incasso | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/forni-a-legna-da-incasso): Built-in wood-fired ovens for kitchens, taverns and gardens.
- [Barbecue da Giardino in Muratura o Acciaio - Vibrok |](https://www.vibrok.it/barbecue): Garden barbecues in masonry or steel for wood and charcoal grilling.

## Biomass Heating & Accessories

- [Caldaie a Biomasse (Pellet, Nocciolino, Mais, Sansa, Gusci, ecc...) | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/caldaie): Biomass boilers for heating and hot water with multi-fuel capability.
- [Accessori per Stufe, Camini, Termocamini, Caldaie e Forni | Vibrok](https://www.vibrok.it/accessori): Accessories and spare parts for Vibrok heating and cooking products.
